temporary_file_probe.scope: Actual temporary-file-only Windows I/O experiment. No live metadata mutation or image calls.

mechanism_and_limit: Temporary files reproduced ordinary readers blocking replacement. A reader sharing deletion alone still failed os.replace on this machine; combined delete-shared reader plus ReplaceFileW succeeded while old reader returned complete old bytes and a new open saw complete new bytes. This supports mitigation of this mechanism, not identification of which specific process held the live file or a guarantee against all permission failures.
implementation: Windows JSON readers use CreateFileW read/write/delete sharing and owned binary descriptor. Windows JSON replacement uses ReplaceFileW with flags0 preserving target metadata; missing destination falls back to normal first-write rename. Existing bounded PermissionError retries remain, invalid/missing JSON still fails, no cache or service request replay. Other platforms use ordinary binary file reads and atomic replace.
